profile.scope: Shipped settings UI and native profile in owned windows; synthetic devices and a local test issuer. This is not enrollment or testing of the owner’s physical Mac or a deployed account service.

limits: Two sandboxed production Flash windows with distinct stores on one macOS runner and in one Electron process; actual RTCDataChannel.
Profile test uses shipped settings controllers/CSS and actual nativeImage, but an owned settings-shell fixture and injected file-picker paths.
Device protector, issuer and owner bootstrap are disposable test fixtures; not Keychain, physical owner device enrollment or a public account service.
No two-physical-device, WAN/NAT coverage, Windows build, 100 GB or terabyte transfer is demonstrated.
File commit requires hard-link support. exFAT support and durable final-ack recovery require separate work.
Public broker/STUN/account endpoint, account recovery/linking, billing and paid entitlement are not deployed or implemented by this receipt.
100000000000 payload bytes per logical transfer is the prototype default; the billing period has not been confirmed by the owner.
Mac version and release remain 6.0.44; Windows/Linux remain 6.0.42. No main merge or product publication is certified by this receipt.
